name: Navigate the complete public site and sitemap
description: Verifies the primary public routes and SEO sitemap index are deployable and connected.
steps: Open Services and use the keyboard skip link
Open Privacy and Terms from the footer or sitemap
Open Sitemap from the homepage footer
expected: All destinations load as branded pages without AccessDenied, Privacy and Terms are reachable, and the sitemap exposes the current public page structure.

name: Complete the calendar-first meeting flow
description: Verifies visitors can choose a slot, continue to the compact details stage and place the tentative meeting on their own calendar.
steps: Choose a meeting format and duration
Inspect Google Calendar and Apple / Outlook calendar actions
expected: The details stage appears with a Google Calendar link and ICS download for the selected tentative slot while final confirmation remains email-based.

name: Prevent continuation without a meeting slot
description: Verifies visitors cannot reach the details stage before choosing both a date and a time.
steps: Open Book a meeting on mobile
Do not select a date or time
Select a date but not a time
expected: Continue remains disabled until a time slot is selected, and the scheduler stays usable without horizontal overflow.

name: Review partners and Google review channel
description: Verifies the partner layout no longer crops names and the duplicate first-party review form has been removed.
steps: Confirm all five partner cards are fully readable
expected: Partners render in a balanced three-plus-two layout, no names are clipped, and reviews use only the official Google channel.

name: Check updated contact, founder and social details
description: Verifies the updated company contact details and founder emails are visible, the Facebook destination is current, and the removed Instagram showcase does not remain on the homepage.
steps: Navigate to Core Team and inspect Hammad, Ahmad and Usman email links
Navigate to FAQ and Start a Conversation and inspect the contact email
Open the Facebook social link and verify its destination
Confirm there is no standalone Instagram showcase between Google Reviews and Global Delivery
expected: Hammad links to hammad@mettglobal.com, Ahmad links to ahmad@mettglobal.com, Usman links to usman@mettglobal.com, general contact and meeting references use contact@mettglobal.com, Facebook uses the new page link, and the standalone Instagram showcase is absent.
